driving.title: Parked? Passenger mode
driving.body: Typing is locked while the car is moving. If you are a passenger and not driving, you can unlock it for this session.
driving.bodyNoOverride: Typing is locked while the car is moving. Park the car to use the keyboard.

nowplaying.nothingHint: Start music in Spotify or YouTube, or turn on the demo player in Settings > Media.
nowplaying.volumeExternal: Volume: use the car or iPhone volume buttons

dashboard.weatherNoLocation: Turn on location to see the weather.
dashboard.setFavoritesHint: Save Home and Work in Maps to navigate in one tap.

maps.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 letters to search.
maps.pressSearch: Press Search on the keyboard to look this up.
maps.locationDenied: Location is blocked. Allow it for DriveDeck in iOS Settings > Privacy > Location Services to see yourself on the map.

youtube.signInBody: Sign in to see your playlists and liked videos. Search also works with just an API key.
youtube.notConfiguredTitle: YouTube is not set up yet
youtube.notConfiguredBody: Add a Google Client ID (sign-in) or a YouTube API key (search only) in Settings > Accounts. The README explains how.
youtube.keyHint: Tip: an API key alone is enough for Search and public playlists.
youtube.searchHint: Search results are cached for an hour to save daily quota.
youtube.linkPlaceholder: Paste a YouTube video or playlist link
youtube.badLink: That does not look like a YouTube link.
youtube.emptyPlaylist: This playlist has no playable videos.
youtube.parkedBody: YouTube video is paused while the car is moving. It resumes when you stop, or if a passenger takes over.
youtube.attribution: Videos play in the official YouTube player. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC; DriveDeck is not affiliated with YouTube. Playback only works while DriveDeck is open on screen.

destinations.slotsHint: Set {{slots}} from a destination in Maps.

spotify.attribution: Music and artwork from Spotify. DriveDeck is a remote control for the Spotify app and is not affiliated with Spotify.
spotify.connectBody: Sign in once so DriveDeck can control the Spotify app. Playback stays in Spotify, so your steering-wheel buttons keep working.
spotify.notConfiguredTitle: Spotify is not set up yet
spotify.notConfiguredBody: Add your Spotify Client ID in Settings > Accounts (see the README for how to create one).
spotify.openAppBody: Spotify has to be running on this iPhone. Open it, start any song, then come back. DriveDeck takes over automatically.
spotify.openAppIdle: Spotify is open but idle. Start a song in Spotify and DriveDeck will pick it up.
spotify.premiumBody: Spotify only allows remote control for Premium accounts. You can still use Spotify itself and the steering-wheel buttons.
spotify.rateLimitedBody: Too many requests. DriveDeck pauses for a moment and retries.
